spec_match.rationale: Models the exact HTTP/3 DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x78ae) and CLOSE_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x2843) capsules and the ready -> draining -> closed Promise resolution order defined in the W3C WebTransport specification.

interactive.rationale: Provides interactive controls for drain grace period, active in-flight stream count, max stream duration, and one-click presets that dynamically update the capsule comparison cards and Promise timeline table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index blurb promising an HTTP/3 capsule wire comparator alongside the three-stage Promise lifecycle and in-flight stream survival counts.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers zero-second grace windows (where 0x78ae behaves like an immediate close), tight grace windows where long streams are truncated, and generous grace windows with 100% stream survival.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified slider and preset interactions, timeline updates, and responsive layout on 360px mobile and 1280px desktop viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry.assert('capsule-timeline-calculated') on load and control changes with zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Uses exclusively CSS variables from /public/styles.css, sets both background and color on button rules, and contains zero raw hex/rgba/hsla values.

accessibility.rationale: All form controls have explicit <label> associations and 44px minimum height, scrollable blocks have tabindex='0', and live updates announce via aria-live='polite'.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive grid cards and .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto } prevent horizontal page overflow at 360px mobile widths.

guidanceConsulted.query: defer rendering heavy content below the fold
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size on off-screen reference and code sections.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .deferred-section to the code path and see-also sections.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible range and select inputs with 44px touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair every range and select input with a visible <label> and ensure a minimum 44px hit target.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped #grace-range, #inflight-count, and #avg-duration in explicit <label> elements with min-height: 44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible wire byte blocks and live timeline output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide tabindex='0' and aria-label on scrollable monospace blocks and aria-live='polite' on dynamic summary outputs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added tabindex='0' and aria-label to .wire-bytes and <pre>, and aria-live='polite' to #inspector-verdict.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive timeline table on 360px mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide tables in overflow-x: auto wrappers and use auto-fit CSS Grid tracks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped the 6-column timeline table inside .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; }.

summary: HTTP/3 DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x78ae) vs CLOSE_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x2843) wire frame and Promise lifecycle comparator.
